summary: Mobile App Experience Polish Pass - All features tested and working. Verified responsive layouts, tap targets, bottom navigation, empty states, and mobile-specific views for both seeker and employer flows.

SEEKER FLOW: Offers page renders offer cards with Accept/Decline buttons accessible on mobile
EMPLOYER FLOW: Dashboard heading responsive, stats cards 3-col grid, Post New Job button full-width (358px)
EMPLOYER FLOW: Candidates page has back button, responsive stats cards (3-col grid)
EMPLOYER FLOW: Post Job form has progress tracker and mobile sticky submit bar
EMPTY STATES: Matches page empty state has icon + message + CTA button
EMPTY STATES: Offers page empty state has icon + message + CTA button
BOTTOM NAV: Mobile bottom nav renders with 5 items for seeker role
BOTTOM NAV: Mobile bottom nav renders with 5 items for employer role

BOTTOM NAV: Active indicator dot renders correctly with relative positioning
BOTTOM NAV: Active state changes correctly when navigating between tabs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile UX polish pass complete. All responsive improvements verified: (1) Mobile navigation with 5 tabs and active indicator dot, (2) Button tap targets meet 56px minimum, (3) Responsive headings (text-xl on mobile, text-2xl+ on desktop), (4) Mobile sticky bars on landing page and job form, (5) Full-screen detail view on Matches page with back button for mobile, (6) Empty states have icon + message + CTA.
